meta.name: google-maps-scraper
meta.description: Free and open-source Google Maps scraper using Docker. Use when the user wants to find businesses, extract leads, emails, reviews, or ratings from Google Maps. Triggers on requests like "find all <business type> in <city>", "scrape Google Maps for <keyword>", "get leads from Google Maps". Keywords: google maps, scrape, business, leads, restaurants, shops, places, reviews, ratings, emails, contacts.

copy.tagline: 从谷歌地图批量提取商家线索和联系方式
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从谷歌地图批量获取商家信息和联系方式
copy.tagline_en: Extract business leads and contacts from Google Maps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to bulk extract business info and contacts from Google Maps

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据你的要求，自动用 Docker 在后台运行 Google Maps 爬虫，提取商家列表、联系方式、评论和评分，最后以表格形式展示结果。
howto.when: 当你提出“找<某类商家>在<某城市>”、“爬取 Google Maps 上<关键词>的信息”或“获取 Google Maps 上的线索”等请求时触发。

say.text: 帮我找柏林的所有牙医。

say.text: 爬取纽约的咖啡店，提取邮箱。
say.note: Claude 会启用邮箱提取功能。

say.text: 在伦敦找评分4.5以上的意大利餐厅。
say.note: Claude 爬取后可按评分筛选。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can automatically run a Google Maps scraper in the background using Docker, extracting business listings, contact details, reviews, and ratings, then presenting results in a table.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to find businesses in a city, scrape Google Maps for a keyword, or get leads from Google Maps.

say_en.note: Claude will start scraping and show results.

say_en.text: Scrape coffee shops in New York and extract emails.
Find Italian restaurants in London with rating above 4.5.
